# `app.graycard.catalog.lensType`

Lens model/type. Instances reference this record. Focal-length and aperture fields use 1e6 scaling to match the photo EXIF projection.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/catalog/lensType.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`

## `variant`

A mount- or market-specific version of a lens model.
